# Source delivery and future binary responsibilities

This candidate includes project source and explicitly listed resources: the SheetJS vendor archive (Apache-2.0, archive/license hashes verified), Adobe font (OFL), original icon (MIT), structured policy catalog and legal/provenance evidence. Apart from those listed resources, npm-installed dependency trees, native addons, OCR WASM, training models, raw policy originals and the derived QA image are **not bundled**. A missing historical standalone notice is not described as a proven conflict or a blanket bar to this source delivery.

## Native and OCR binaries

- [Native source provenance](native-source-provenance.json) pins Canvas/Skia, all 93 Rust crate archive checksums, 12 enabled Skia dependency notice sets, nine WASM build submodules, the exact published WASM/JS wrapper Git blobs and four exact training-data gzip blobs.
- The two non-integerized models also match the original upstream model Git blobs after decompression. The integerized variants match the exact published compressed source blobs; integerization was not rerun. MIT wrapper declarations and Apache-2.0 data licensing are separate scopes.
- Native platform binaries are not shipped here. For a future binary release, reconcile the actual target component manifest, final linkage and all accompanying notices. Native source rebuilds and application target-package notice validation remain NOT_RUN.
- OpenLibm distinguishes runtime MIT/BSD/ISC/FDLIBM code from LGPL test files. The existence of those test files is not treated as an established runtime copyleft conflict.

## Policy materials and bundled assets

- Policy official originals and derived QA image are not bundled. Source URLs and pinned hashes remain in the [root-maintained policy manifest](policy-source-manifest.json). Downloads require the explicit [cache command](../scripts/cache-policy-sources.mjs); cached bytes must match the pinned hash. The structured offline catalog remains versioned separately; project MIT does not claim to relicense government or other source material.
- Adobe Source Han Sans and the vendor SheetJS tarball are actually bundled source assets, with verified provenance and their original OFL/Apache notices retained. The SVG/PNG icon is original project MIT artwork with a reproducible generator.
